name: /ai-export
description: Generate a comprehensive system understanding document from the current project

steps.action: Discover the current project and generate an AI export document
steps.context: Generate an external-AI handoff for the project that contains this .exocortex directory. First identify the project root, repository type, primary languages/frameworks, package/build files, entrypoints, source directories, tests, docs, and Exocortex memory files that exist in this project. Read actual project files; do not assume app-specific filenames, frameworks, domains, or architecture. Prefer source-of-truth files such as README files, package manifests, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, composer.json, src/, app/, lib/, tests/, docs/, .exocortex/PROJECT_MEMORY.md, .exocortex/LESSONS.md, and .exocortex/control/ARCH_OVERVIEW.md when present. Do not read secrets or expose secret values; avoid .env files and credential stores. Build a 7-section markdown document: 1) System Overview, 2) Architecture, 3) Component Responsibilities with brief evidence-backed file references, 4) Data Flow and execution paths, 5) QA Strategy with real test commands/counts when discoverable, 6) Constraints & Invariants from code/docs/memory, 7) Risks, Gaps, and Unknowns. If evidence is missing, say so clearly instead of guessing. Write to AI_EXPORT_v{N}.md with changelog, confidence assessment, validation date, and a short list of files inspected.
